title: Consumer goods ontology
description: Portable consumer-goods semantics imported from the supplied Lattice ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: consumer-goods
  title: Consumer Goods Ontology
  description: Fundamental entities and relationships shared across Consumer Goods decision contracts.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: consumer-goods-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:f9f322670bc8e0bbd2bfef752b4e3cebdd3f9367300974fc05c97985d51d8ceb
spec:
  types:
    - id: product
      label: Product
      description: A governed stock-keeping unit (SKU) or sellable item.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: product.product_id
          label: Product Id
          description: Stable product identifier (SKU).
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: product.product_name
          label: Product Name
          description: Trade name of the product.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: product.brand
          label: Brand
          description: Marketing brand.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: product.category
          label: Category
          description: Category such as food, beverage, personal care, household.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: product.upc
          label: UPC
          description: Universal Product Code (barcode).
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
        - id: product.uom
          label: UOM
          description: Unit of measure such as each, case, pallet, kg, l.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/5
        - id: product.launch_date
          label: Launch Date
          description: Date the product was launched.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/6
    - id: shipment
      label: Shipment
      description: A governed inbound or outbound shipment of goods.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: shipment.shipment_id
          label: Shipment Id
          description: Stable shipment identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: shipment.shipment_type
          label: Shipment Type
          description: Inbound PO, customer order, transfer, returns.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: shipment.shipped_at
          label: Shipped At
          description: Ship date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: shipment.expected_delivery
          label: Expected Delivery
          description: Expected delivery date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
        - id: shipment.carrier
          label: Carrier
          description: Carrier or freight provider.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/4
        - id: shipment.tracking_number
          label: Tracking Number
          description: Carrier tracking number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/5
        - id: shipment.status
          label: Status
          description: Created, in-transit, delivered, delayed, lost.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/6
    - id: purchase_order
      label: Purchase Order
      description: A governed purchase order from a buyer to a supplier.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: purchase_order.po_number
          label: PO Number
          description: Purchase order number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: purchase_order.order_date
          label: Order Date
          description: Date the PO was placed.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: purchase_order.supplier
          label: Supplier
          description: Supplier name or identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: purchase_order.total_amount
          label: Total Amount
          description: Total PO amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: purchase_order.currency
          label: Currency
          description: Currency code.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
        - id: purchase_order.status
          label: Status
          description: Open, partial, received, closed, cancelled.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/5
    - id: sales_order
      label: Sales Order
      description: A governed customer sales order or invoice line set.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: sales_order.order_id
          label: Sales Order Id
          description: Stable sales order identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: sales_order.order_date
          label: Order Date
          description: Date the order was placed.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: sales_order.channel
          label: Channel
          description: Sales channel such as retail, e-commerce, wholesale, D2C.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: sales_order.total_amount
          label: Total Amount
          description: Total order amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: sales_order.currency
          label: Currency
          description: Currency code.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
        - id: sales_order.status
          label: Status
          description: Placed, paid, fulfilled, returned, cancelled.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/5
    - id: inventory_snapshot
      label: Inventory Snapshot
      description: A dated snapshot of on-hand, inbound, or available inventory for a product at a location.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: inventory_snapshot.snapshot_id
          label: Snapshot Id
          description: Stable inventory snapshot identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: inventory_snapshot.snapshot_date
          label: Snapshot Date
          description: Date of the snapshot.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: inventory_snapshot.on_hand_qty
          label: On Hand Qty
          description: Quantity on hand.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: inventory_snapshot.inbound_qty
          label: Inbound Qty
          description: Quantity inbound.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: inventory_snapshot.reserved_qty
          label: Reserved Qty
          description: Quantity reserved.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: inventory_snapshot.uom
          label: UOM
          description: Unit of measure.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
    - id: promotion
      label: Promotion
      description: A governed trade promotion, discount, or campaign.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: promotion.promotion_id
          label: Promotion Id
          description: Stable promotion identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: promotion.promotion_name
          label: Promotion Name
          description: Name of the promotion.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: promotion.start_date
          label: Start Date
          description: Promotion start date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: promotion.end_date
          label: End Date
          description: Promotion end date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: promotion.discount_pct
          label: Discount Pct
          description: Discount percentage.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: promotion.discount_amount
          label: Discount Amount
          description: Fixed discount amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
        - id: promotion.promotion_type
          label: Promotion Type
          description: Trade, consumer, BOGO, TPR, markdown.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/6
    # Shared core types
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
    - id: asset
      label: Asset
      description: A governed physical, digital, or financial resource.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:
        - id: asset.asset_id
          label: Asset identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the asset.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0
        - id: asset.name
          label: Asset name
          description: Human-readable asset name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1
        - id: asset.asset_type
          label: Asset type
          description: Governed classification of the asset.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/2
    - id: policy
      label: Policy
      description: A versioned rule or standard governing decisions and actions.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13
      properties:
        - id: policy.policy_id
          label: Policy identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the policy.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/0
        - id: policy.title
          label: Policy title
          description: Authoritative policy title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/1
        - id: policy.version
          label: Version
          description: Approved policy version.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/2
        - id: policy.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which the policy applies.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/3
  relationships:
    - id: shipment_includes_product
      label: INCLUDES_PRODUCT
      description: Shipment includes a product.
      sourceTypeId: shipment
      targetTypeId: product
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/0
    - id: shipment_fulfills_po
      label: FULFILLS_PO
      description: Shipment fulfills a purchase order.
      sourceTypeId: shipment
      targetTypeId: purchase_order
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/1
    - id: shipment_fulfills_sales_order
      label: FULFILLS_SALES_ORDER
      description: Shipment fulfills a sales order.
      sourceTypeId: shipment
      targetTypeId: sales_order
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/2
    - id: po_lines_product
      label: FOR_PRODUCT
      description: Purchase order is for a product.
      sourceTypeId: purchase_order
      targetTypeId: product
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/3
    - id: sales_order_lines_product
      label: FOR_PRODUCT
      description: Sales order includes a product.
      sourceTypeId: sales_order
      targetTypeId: product
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/4
    - id: inventory_snapshot_for_product
      label: FOR_PRODUCT
      description: Inventory snapshot is for a product.
      sourceTypeId: inventory_snapshot
      targetTypeId: product
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/5
    - id: inventory_snapshot_at_location
      label: AT_LOCATION
      description: Inventory snapshot located at a location.
      sourceTypeId: inventory_snapshot
      targetTypeId: location
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/6
    - id: promotion_targets_product
      label: TARGETS_PRODUCT
      description: Promotion applies to a product.
      sourceTypeId: promotion
      targetTypeId: product
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/7
    - id: member_of
      label: MEMBER_OF
      description: A person is affiliated with an organization.
      sourceTypeId: person
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/8
    - id: acts_for
      label: ACTS_FOR
      description: An agent acts on behalf of an organization.
      sourceTypeId: agent
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/9
    - id: located_at
      label: LOCATED_AT
      description: An organization operates at a location.
      sourceTypeId: organization
      targetTypeId: location
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/10
    - id: documents
      label: DOCUMENTS
      description: A document records or describes an event.
      sourceTypeId: document
      targetTypeId: event
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/11
    - id: involves_asset
      label: INVOLVES_ASSET
      description: An event involves a governed asset.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: asset
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/12
    - id: governed_by_policy
      label: GOVERNED_BY_POLICY
      description: An event is governed by an applicable policy.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: policy
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/13
    - id: owned_by_organization
      label: OWNED_BY_ORGANIZATION
      description: An asset is owned or stewarded by an organization.
      sourceTypeId: asset
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/14
